office_does: A Yakima County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil cases up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; the four judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Brian Sanderson is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Yakima County District Court judge since 2010, previously Selah Municipal Court judge, assistant attorney general and public defender; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since his 2010 election; unopposed in 2022 [S1][S3]
Earlier Selah Municipal Court judge, special prosecutor, public defender and assistant attorney general [S1]
Has taught continuing legal education and served on courtroom-technology workgroups [S1]
